title: OpenOKR: delivery and the background
description: Everything that happens after a request has returned, or because a clock said so. Nobody is watching a screen when this goes wrong, which is the whole reason it is charted.

panels.title: Oldest row still waiting
panels.description: Read at scrape time, not written during a drain. A relay that has stopped reports a lag that grows; a counter would go flat and the outage would read as a quiet queue.

panels.title: Outbox dispatch, by outcome
panels.description: `failed` will be tried again. `dead_lettered` is work this instance gave up on, and somebody has to look at it.

panels.title: Dead letters, by topic
panels.description: Any line above zero is a standing obligation. Nothing else in the product will mention these.

panels.title: Nudges, by what happened
panels.description: `deferred` is quiet hours queueing to the next open window, which is a delivery that is going to happen. It is charted apart from the suppressions for that reason.

panels.title: Channel delivery, by provider and outcome
Scheduled jobs, by outcome
panels.description: Counted per workspace. A job that succeeds in twenty-nine and fails in the thirtieth shows both lines, which a per-job outcome could not.

panels.title: Agent runs, by trigger and outcome
AI spend, by provider and model
panels.description: The authoritative record is `ai_usage_events`, which survives a restart and answers a bill. This is the same numbers moving today.

panels.title: Authorisation refusals, by action
panels.description: A spike here is either a permission that was narrowed or somebody probing. The subject is deliberately not a label, so this says what was refused and never which row.
